req_spec.title: Search, filters, sorting and result feedback
req_spec.scope: Member 4 / D only. README.md TF-REQ-019 and Behaviour notes; code-derived details in src/utils/tasks.js, src/components/TaskToolbar.jsx, TopBar.jsx, TaskList.jsx, and src/App.jsx. Fixture setup is not an assertion about CRUD, storage, status transitions, summary counts, or navigation.

requirement.title: Trimmed case-insensitive title substring
requirement.description: A nonblank trimmed query shall match a case-insensitive substring of title. Source: README.md (TF-REQ-019 / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); src/utils/tasks.js filterAndSortTasks; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Description substring and title-or-description
requirement.description: A nonblank query shall match a case-insensitive substring in description or title; either field is sufficient. Source: README.md (TF-REQ-019 / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); src/utils/tasks.js filterAndSortTasks; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Blank query and literal punctuation
requirement.description: A query that becomes empty after trim shall not restrict results. Punctuation is literal substring data; no query length limit is specified. Source: README.md (TF-REQ-019 / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); src/utils/tasks.js filterAndSortTasks; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Synchronized search boxes
requirement.description: TopBar and TaskToolbar inputs shall share the same controlled query; typing in either changes the other input and visible results. Source: README.md (TF-REQ-019 / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); src/App.jsx search state; src/components/TopBar.jsx; src/components/TaskToolbar.jsx; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Status filter partitions
requirement.description: All Statuses includes all tasks; To Do, In Progress, and Completed include tasks of only the selected status. Source: README.md (TF-REQ-019 / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); src/components/TaskToolbar.jsx; src/utils/tasks.js filterAndSortTasks; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Priority filter partitions
requirement.description: All Priorities includes all tasks; Low, Medium, and High include tasks of only the selected priority. Source: README.md (TF-REQ-019 / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); src/components/TaskToolbar.jsx; src/utils/tasks.js filterAndSortTasks; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Search/status/priority AND decision table
requirement.description: Visible tasks satisfy status AND priority AND query; query condition is title OR description match. Source: README.md (TF-REQ-019 / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); README.md TF-REQ-019 / Behaviour notes; src/utils/tasks.js filterAndSortTasks; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Four sorts and newest default
requirement.description: Newest first is the default; choices are Newest first, Oldest first, Due date: soonest, and Due date: latest. Source: README.md (TF-REQ-019 / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); src/utils/tasks.js SORT_OPTIONS/filterAndSortTasks; src/components/TaskToolbar.jsx; src/App.jsx; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Creation order and due-date tie order
requirement.description: Newest orders createdAt descending; Oldest orders createdAt ascending. Tasks with equal due dates are ordered by newest createdAt first. Source: README.md (TF-REQ-019 / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); src/utils/tasks.js filterAndSortTasks comparators/byDueDate; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Undated-last behavior
requirement.description: Due-date sorts place every dated task before undated tasks; undated tasks are ordered newest createdAt first. Source: README.md (TF-REQ-019 / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); README.md Behaviour notes; src/utils/tasks.js filterAndSortTasks byDueDate; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Singular and plural result counts
requirement.description: When results exist, display Showing <visible> of <total> task for total 1 and Showing <visible> of <total> tasks otherwise; total counts all tasks before filters. Source: README.md (TF-REQ-019 / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); src/components/TaskList.jsx result-count; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: No-result message precedence and actions
requirement.description: With zero total tasks show No tasks yet / Tasks you create will appear here. / Create your first task. Otherwise zero results with nonblank trimmed search show No tasks match "<query>" / Try a different search term. / Clear search. With blank search show No tasks match the current filters / Try changing or clearing your filters. / Clear filters. Source: README.md (TF-REQ-019 / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); README.md Exact messages / Empty states; src/components/TaskList.jsx; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Clear search preserves filters and sort
requirement.description: The search empty-state Clear search action clears only search and preserves status, priority, and sort. Source: README.md (TF-REQ-019 / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); src/components/TaskList.jsx onClearSearch; src/App.jsx setSearch; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Both Clear Filters actions reset all controls
requirement.description: Toolbar Clear Filters and filter-empty-state Clear filters clear search, set status and priority to All, and restore newest sort. Source: README.md (TF-REQ-019 / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); src/App.jsx clearFilters; src/components/TaskToolbar.jsx; src/components/TaskList.jsx onClearFilters; baseline main@5133a6c.
